narrative.overview: Money is a measurement. The app reads like a small, calm piece of lab equipment: ruled readouts, a tick scale for the period, one spectrum chart. Dark first (Ink), with a light Bench sibling. Depth is tonal panels and 1dp hairlines; no shadows. Two fixed channels, Received green and Spent amber, never change with the one switchable accent, which colours chrome only. Every number is Geist Mono tabular.
keyCharacteristics: Ink and Bench palettes, tonal panels plus 1dp hairlines, zero shadows.
Two money channels independent of five selectable accents.
Geist Mono tabular for every number; UI text in a user-chosen face.
Small radii (8 to 20dp), nothing is a pill; add key is 10dp.
Instrument furniture is local: graticule in the chart, tick ruler on the period control, leaders on Home's three summary rows.

rules.name: The Two Channels Rule
rules.body: Received is green and Spent is amber in every theme and under every accent. The accent never borrows either hue, and amber is never an accent.

rules.name: The Sign Plus Colour Rule
rules.body: A money event is never told apart by colour alone: amounts carry a visible + or - and rows carry an arrow glyph.

rules.name: The Faint Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: The faint grey is for marks. Words use text or dim.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every digit that stands for money, a date range, a percentage or a count is in Geist Mono with tabular figures. Words are never in mono.

rules.name: The 12sp Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set below 12sp. All sizes are sp and follow the system font size.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1dp hairline or a tonal step. Never with a shadow.

dos: Do use Gap and Radii constants; build on the 4dp grid.
Do put every number in Geist Mono tabular, and sign every amount with + or - plus its channel colour.
Do keep the accent on chrome only and Received and Spent on money only.
Do separate with hairlines (1dp) and tonal panels, in both Ink and Bench.
Do keep touch targets at 48dp or larger, text at 12sp or larger, and cap big readouts at 130% text scale while letting everything else scale fully.
Do honour reduce-motion on every animation and give each new animation a skip path.
Do keep all wording in Copy so Lab on and off both stay complete.
Do keep launcher artwork original and fonts bundled under OFL.
donts: Don't add shadows, glow, surface tint, pill buttons, stat cards or donut charts.
Don't offer amber as an accent or let any accent land near the Received green.
Don't use the faint grey for words.
Don't spread leaders, graticule or tick ruler to other screens.
Don't use any show logo, show lettering, or hat-and-glasses silhouette, quote the show, or hard-code a "99.1%" purity figure.
Don't make the Lab flavor change layout or colour.
